AI Overview
Curve Rush is a casual, browser-based endless runner arcade game released in February 2025. 
Curve Rush
 +1
How to Play
Objective: Guide a rolling ball across endless sand dunes or slopes for as long as possible. 
Core Mechanics: Build speed by holding down on downhill slopes, then release to launch the ball into the air. 
Scoring: Chain high jumps and smooth landings to earn bonus points and collect coins. 
Controls: Use the left mouse button, spacebar, or up arrow key (click and hold to gain speed, release to soar, and click again to dive or land). 
Curve Rush
 +2
Failure Condition: A harsh, mistimed, or rough landing immediately ends your run. 
Where to Play
You can play the game for free directly in your web browser without any downloads or installations on sites like Curve Rush.
